declarations.docstring: Under the first auxiliary vertex hypothesis, a representation satisfying the auxiliary condition either has the auxiliary vertex property or has a surjective associated map.
Under the second auxiliary vertex hypothesis, a representation satisfying the auxiliary condition either has the auxiliary vertex property or has an injective associated map.
An auxiliary predicate on a representation of a quiver over a commutative semiring.
An auxiliary vertexwise predicate for a quiver representation whose vertex modules are finite free.
